## Applicability changes within the activity itself

Following Ren's correction, the [new reconstruction](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/NONDUAL-APPLICABILITY-INTEGRATION.md) returns to an actual relation already present in the formation history. Repair changes the damaged capture site into an intact one, removing its own enabling condition and restoring capture access. Capture fills local storage; actual consumption can reopen it while the site remains intact. The activity changes the conditions of further activity without a separately installed completion label or reward.

The new trace theorem establishes that an admitted later repair after restoration requires actual intervening damage. The existing 94-event formation ancestor supplies a non-exhaustion witness: repair and capture are disabled despite 293 common fuel and 216 source units. Two bounded suffixes show renewed repair after damage, and local use followed by capture. These are alternatives at that reached ancestor, not extra work silently inserted before the old successor assembly. Captured local fuel does not renew common repair fuel; the old finite-resource bounds remain.

The recipient-identification audit establishes a complementary limit of representation. Changing initial cumulative patient credit preserves every admitted event word, although the recorded patient outcome and total energy change. The law does not model the recipient's own use of support, restoration or renewed activity. It therefore omits the very relation that would make a receipt consequential for that recipient's continuation. This does not establish that significance lies outside generative reality. Likewise, ten-unit and twenty-unit service questions change a supplied question binding; they do not hold the whole actual request/dependency configuration fixed.

The [separate fresh build](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/connected/nondual/verification.json) passes all 55 bound modules. Twenty-seven audits are new; the import entry adds no theorem, and inherited mathematical dependencies remain. [Review](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/NONDUAL-APPLICABILITY-REVIEW.md) accepts the local scope. This reconstructs a positive relation and diagnoses a model omission; it does not prove nondual ontology, the origin of the physical laws, acquired ethical understanding or complete alignment.
